Aisha Walcott-Bryant

- [Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=https://blog.google/intl/en-africa/company-news/outreach-and-initiatives/applied-ai-lab-cohort-2026/&title=Meet%20the%2010%20startups%20joining%20the%20first%20Google%20Africa%20Applied%20AI%20Lab%20cohort)
- Copy link

A woman in Nigeria who has never touched a smartphone dials a number on her basic handset, asks a question in Hausa, and hears the answer read back to her by AI. These are not ideas on a whiteboard.

Pioneered by African founders, these products demonstrate the profound impact of AI when it is built from the ground up to align with local contexts and daily realities across the continent.

We launched the Google Africa Applied AI Lab to accelerate the global impact of African-led products and innovations.

- [**Vendy**](https://vendy.ng/) **(Nigeria):** Lets businesses run storefronts and take payments directly inside WhatsApp.

web.title: Google selects 4 Nigerian startups for 10th accelerator cohort
web.description: Google has announced the selection of 15 pan-African startups for the 10th cohort of its Google for Startups Accelerator Africa program. With nearly 2,600 applications, four Nigerian startups, Bani, MasteryHive AI, Regxta, and Termii, made the final cut, representing an acceptance rate of less than 1%.
